Title: Family Tree Mission
Can-do: I can introduce family or friends with simple phrases.
Student-facing Input: Leo, Mia, Emma, and Toto find photo cards. They make a friendly tree poster. You can use family cards or friend cards.
Model Language: This is my mom. / This is my friend. / This is Toto.
Try It / Output: Point to one card and say one line.
Repair Hint: Use a card first, then choose one short line.

Title: Family Words
Can-do: I can recognize family and friend words.
Student-facing Input: Look at the word cards. Listen and point: mom, dad, sister, brother, grandma, grandpa, friend, dog.
Model Language: mom / dad / sister / brother / grandma / grandpa / friend / dog
Try It / Output: Point to three cards and say the words.
Repair Hint: Match picture to word again. Say only the word first.

Title: This Is My...
Can-do: I can say This is my... with a photo card.
Student-facing Input: Mia shows a card. Leo listens. Use the frame: This is my ___.
Model Language: This is my mom. / This is my dad. / This is my friend. / This is my dog.
Try It / Output: Choose two cards and say two lines.
Repair Hint: Start with This is my, then add one card word.

Title: Who's This?
Can-do: I can ask and answer Who's this?
Student-facing Input: Leo points to a mystery card. Mia answers with a short line.
Model Language: A: Who's this? B: It's my mom. / It's my friend.
Try It / Output: Ask one question and answer with one card.
Repair Hint: Question: Who's this? Answer: It's my ___.

Title: Family and Friends
Can-do: I can introduce a friend or Toto.
Student-facing Input: Emma shows a friend card. You can make a poster with family cards or friend cards.
Model Language: This is my friend. / This is Toto. / This is my dog.
Try It / Output: Choose family or friend cards for your poster.
Repair Hint: If you do not want to use a family card, use a friend card.

Title: Read a Mini Tree
Can-do: I can read very short family/friend lines.
Student-facing Input: Read the big cards: This is my mom. This is my dad. This is my friend.
Model Language: This is my mom. / This is my dad. / This is my friend. / This is Toto.
Try It / Output: Read three lines with picture help.
Repair Hint: Read the picture first, then read the line.

Title: Make a Picture Tree
Can-do: I can plan my family/friend poster.
Student-facing Input: Choose 3 or 4 cards. Put them on a tree poster. Copy or choose the sentence frame.
Model Language: This is my ___. / Who's this? / It's my ___.
Try It / Output: Draft your poster with 3 or 4 cards and labels.
Repair Hint: Use the phrase bank. Do not write long sentences.

Title: Say and Show
Can-do: I can show my poster and say 3–4 lines.
Student-facing Input: Mia shows her poster. Leo and Emma listen. Toto sits near the poster.
Model Language: Hello. This is my mom. This is my friend. This is Toto.
Try It / Output: Show your poster. Say 3 lines with a clear voice and a smile.
Repair Hint: Use 3 lines, clear voice, and smile.

Title: Toto's Photo Tree
Can-do: I can understand a short family/friend story.
Student-facing Input: Watch a short silent/captioned story. Toto finds photo cards. The team makes a tree poster.
Model Language: This is my mom. / Who's this? / It's my friend. / This is Toto. / This is my tree.
Try It / Output: Watch, choose the words, and put the story in order.
Repair Hint: Replay with captions. Match each caption to a picture.

Title: My Family/Friend Poster
Can-do: I can make and present a poster.
Student-facing Input: Make a poster with 3 or 4 cards. Use family cards, friend cards, or Toto. Say your lines.
Model Language: This is my mom. / This is my friend. / This is Toto.
Repair Hint: Check: 3 lines, clear voice, smile. Use the phrase bank if needed.
